Delhi Building Collapse Leaves Multiple Casualties

A five-storey building collapsed in New Seemapuri, Delhi. Reports indicate at least three deaths, including a pregnant woman and a child, with eight people injured. Rescue operations are ongoing, with several individuals feared trapped. The incident occurred approximately one month after another building collapse in Delhi's Satya Niketan area.
